about: Single source of truth for what the physical robot is and does. Every fact carries how it was measured, when, where the evidence is, how much to trust it, and the project's verification level (T0 synthetic, T1 replay, T2 external data, T3 hardware-in-the-loop, T4 real robot). Code reads these values through pc/robot_truth.py; a number found in a script that disagrees with this file is the script that is wrong (see pc/pack/const_scan.py).

level_ladder.T3: hardware in the loop (firmware loop compiled to host)

model_artifacts.about: The camera a released model was trained with is that model's, not the robot's: it is recorded in the weights or the manifest and the code that loads the model must use it. None of the released models was trained with the measured camera. Their published accuracy therefore holds only at the camera listed here; the gap column says what is known about the measured camera. Fix = retrain at camera.fov_h_deg / camera.height_m and evaluate once through the registered final-evaluation path.

hover_geonet_240_v3_vit.gap: rays and table prior are network inputs; decoded at 65 deg, real frames come out about 22 % too far in ground range (AUD-015)

hover_mono_depth_v1.gap: one synthetic scene, same weights: AbsRel 0.0455 at this camera, 0.2342 at the measured camera (AUD-016; test_mono_depth.py test_04 prints it)

hover_gaussian_splat_v2.gap: AbsRel 0.0166 at this camera on one synthetic scene; not measured at the measured camera

hover_dense_splat_v3.gap: not measured at the measured camera

legacy_onboard_policy.recorded_in: nothing (convention shared by pc/perception/FOV_H_DEFAULT and the firmware default fov_h)
legacy_onboard_policy.gap: theta_img of the observation is computed at 60 deg; the blobs were trained that way, so the pair must change together or not at all

camera.fov_h_deg.method: teacher-mode body turns of +-30 deg and head steps of +-15 deg, phase correlation of frames against the IMU heading, 6 pairs
camera.fov_h_deg.source: SIM2REAL-REPORT-2026-11-23.md section 1; re-checked 2026-11-24 from 7 head-stage frame pairs (2.0-2.9 px/deg, mean about 2.5), runs_end_side/s2r_live/session_20261124_235030_head
camera.fov_h_deg.uncertainty: about +-2 deg; lens distortion not characterised
camera.fov_h_deg.notes: Roughly the image centre. The sensor can do VGA; this is for the 240x240 mode.

camera.fov_v_deg.method: assumed equal to the horizontal field (square image)
camera.fov_v_deg.notes: Measure before relying on vertical geometry.

camera.height_m.method: measured standing on the desk with the robot upright

camera.mount.value: camera and IMU rigidly on the pan head; pan only, cannot tilt down
camera.mount.method: frame displacement equals IMU heading change

camera.optical_pitch_deg.unit: deg (optical axis below horizontal, positive down)
camera.optical_pitch_deg.uncertainty: up to +-4 deg suspected; at 40 cm that is up to 10 cm of ground-range error
camera.optical_pitch_deg.notes: Needs a printed checkerboard in front of the robot (about 20 s of the user's time).

camera.capture_fps_range.method: frame timestamps of 6 annotated takes and live sessions
camera.capture_fps_range.notes: Not constant: varies with Wi-Fi and robot load.

camera.hand_9cm_px_per_m.method: derived: f_px * 0.09 / distance, with f_px from the measured field of view
camera.hand_9cm_px_per_m.notes: AGENTS.md 5.4-19 says 21 px at 1 m and 10 px at 2 m; those were computed with the old 55-60 deg assumption. With the measured lens a 9 cm hand is about 14 px at 1 m and 7 px at 2 m.

head.deadband_half_width_deg.method: 35 step responses standing on the desk
head.deadband_half_width_deg.notes: Re-measured: a return-to-zero command settles anywhere between -8.2 and +5.4 deg depending on the side it came from (band about 13.6 deg wide). The 10.2 deg figure came from a side-lying bench test and does not apply standing.

head.reach_deg.method: command +-45, read the servo position after it settles

head.step_disturbance.method: 10 head holds of 20-30 deg commanded steps with the body heading held, 500 Hz telemetry
head.step_disturbance.notes: A head step is not a small motion: the balance torque touches its +-100 clip and the body yaw is left 3-4 deg off, inside the heading stiction band where nothing corrects it.

head.reaction_manual_mode.notes: Manual mode has no heading loop.

heading.stiction_lead_deg.unit: deg of yaw lead needed before the body starts to turn

heading.stop_error_deg.unit: deg (range over 12 in-place steps of +-8 and +-15 deg)
heading.stop_error_deg.method: guarded heading servo steps, 2 rounds, wheel-odometry heading
heading.stop_error_deg.source: runs_end_side/s2r_live/session_20261124_235702_heading/analysis.json; morning run 0.8-3.8 deg in SIM2REAL-REPORT-2026-11-23.md section 12
heading.stop_error_deg.notes: Always short of the target, never past it (overshoot 0). Peak yaw lead 9.2-13.0 deg.

heading.wheel_diff_deg_per_cm.unit: deg of body yaw per cm of wheel-difference travel

heading.manual_mode_has_heading_loop.method: firmware source: vyaw is never read under ARB_SRC_MANUAL

balance.lqr_gains.unit: per m, per (wheel speed unit), per deg, per deg/s
balance.lqr_gains.source: rig_omni/main/boards/hover/robot.cc InitializeController; verified against real telemetry: temp_u = -(K0*x_e + K1*(v - vx) + K2*(pitch - imu_zero) + K3*dq), residual < 0.6 at rest, RMS 1.24 in the linear zone while moving

balance.imu_zero_deg.unit: deg (the balance angle the controller assumes)
balance.imu_zero_deg.method: firmware default; runtime-settable through GET /api/set?i=8&v=<deg>, resets on reboot

balance.torque_clips.notes: Yaw torque shares the budget with balance. The bump adds 10 units in the direction of the torque whenever its magnitude exceeds 20.

balance.rest_offset_m_per_deg.unit: m of (wheel_x - stable_pos) per deg of (mechanical balance angle - imu_zero)
balance.rest_offset_m_per_deg.method: -K2/K0 of the firmware LQR, confirmed on three independent rest states
balance.rest_offset_m_per_deg.source: rest pitch 0.19 deg -> 4.2 cm, 1.00 deg -> 6.80 cm, 2.84 deg -> 9.56 cm; pc/s2r/test_guarded_session.py::test_firmware_lqr_identity_on_real_rest_log
balance.rest_offset_m_per_deg.notes: The '4.6 cm balance offset' quoted in earlier documents is one point on this line, not a constant.

balance.rest_pitch_deg_observed.unit: deg (range seen across sessions and within one hour)
balance.rest_pitch_deg_observed.notes: The rest pitch drifts by about 0.75 deg per hour with the wheels still; do not treat it as a constant.

balance.static_friction_torque.unit: firmware torque units (no wheel motion below about 20, break-away between 20 and 30)
balance.static_friction_torque.method: slow ramp of the balance angle reference (0.2 deg/s) with 500 Hz telemetry
balance.static_friction_torque.notes: Equivalent to about +-2.3 cm of position lead or +-1.2 deg of balance angle. On a desk mat; not measured on a hard surface.

balance.fore_aft_mode_hz.method: dominant frequency of the pitch oscillation after a position-lead step

balance.lead_step_response.method: open-loop velocity pulse vx=+0.05 m/s for 0.4 s
balance.lead_step_response.notes: A position-lead step inside the friction band is absorbed as body pitch and a fore-aft rocking, not as travel. This is the mechanism behind 'it does not move forward' and 'it rocks back and forth'.

balance.roll_rest_deg.unit: deg (passive lean across the wheel axle; range -4.2 to -5.7 in one evening, -12 to +5.5 during motion)

balance.roll_is_unfiltered.method: firmware computes roll from raw accelerometer samples; a head-servo start moved it from -4.9 to +6.3 deg for two samples
balance.roll_is_unfiltered.notes: Any roll threshold must be debounced for at least 60 ms.

value.pickup: wheel speed > 350 for more than 8 samples

imu.gyro_yaw_bias_dps.unit: deg/s (magnitude of drift over 8-30 s windows after the 2026-11-24 firmware patch)
imu.gyro_yaw_bias_dps.method: heading drift over 8-30 s windows while standing
imu.gyro_yaw_bias_dps.notes: Before the patch the yaw gyro bias was -3.7 to -5.6 deg/s and a 5 deg/s gate zeroed it.

imu.colocated_with_camera.method: the telemetry yaw is the camera's absolute heading; frame shift / delta yaw = 2.0-2.9 px/deg
imu.colocated_with_camera.notes: Do not add the head servo angle to the IMU yaw to get the camera heading: that double counts and halves the apparent field of view.

firmware.control_period_ms.method: firmware source: three vTaskDelay(2) per cycle

firmware.cfg_defaults.notes: Runtime only (RAM, no NVS write); resets on reboot. fov_h = 60 disagrees with camera.fov_h_deg: it only sets theta_img of the legacy onboard policy, whose blobs were trained with 60 deg, so the two change together or not at all (see model_artifacts).

value.subscription: any UDP datagram to the port

firmware.telemetry.method: measured packet rate and sequence numbers

latency.capture_robot_side_ms.unit: ms per GET /capture on the robot (about 10 ms waiting for the next sensor frame + 21.7 ms JPEG + transfer)

latency.transport_minimal_perception_p50.unit: ms end to end, p50, POST /step path with YOLO features on the PC
latency.transport_minimal_perception_p50.method: pc/tools/e2e_latency.py --n 60 --step, 60 round trips after a warm-up

latency.s2r_dry_perception_to_command_p5.unit: ms p50 (2026-11-24 acceptance: about 40 ms at 17 fps; 2026-11-23: 56 ms at 14.4 fps)
latency.s2r_dry_perception_to_command_p5.method: s2r/live.py --mode dry loop timing (exposure to command)
latency.s2r_dry_perception_to_command_p5.notes: Two different evenings, different desk lighting and load; treat as a range.
